opening.argument: The presentation ties BUSD rewards to paid program levels, invited partners, and positions in a matrix. Registration activates X3 and X4 levels costing 5 BUSD each, while invited partners fill matrix spots and trigger rewards automatically through the smart contract. The structure further assigns percentage-based rewards to spots on successive lines, including 30% from four spots and 70% from eight, with recycled amounts transferred to an upline. It recommends activating the first three levels in each program at the start and urges viewers to begin. Although it denies being an investment program and says results depend on participant actions, it also promotes rapid, substantial participant outcomes, including claims of dollar millionaires within 3-8 weeks. These features establish recruitment-linked, tiered participation built around paid activation and matrix rewards.

citations.quote: When you register with Forsage, the first levels of X3 and X4 programs that costs 5 BUSD each are activated.
When you invite partners, they register in your structure and fill out the spots in your Matrix.
From the second line you get 30% from each of the four spots. From the third line you get 70% from 8 spots.
it's recommended to activate at least the first three levels in each program at the start this ensures good initial results
Many participants have achieved amazing financial result, changing their whole lives in the first 3-8 weeks of getting started with Forsage and some even became dollar millionaires.
